Overview

Taubaté is a city in SP with a population of 320,820. A historic city in the Paraíba Valley, known for its colonial past, automotive industry, and as the birthplace of Monteiro Lobato. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
